rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something randomly or chaotically.

example.english: They did their homework haphazardly, leaving it all over the place and missing many questions.
example.traditional: 佢做功課亂咁寫，寫到周圍都係，仲漏咗好多題。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 gung1 fo3 lyun6 gam3 se2 se2 dou3 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6 zung6 lau6 zo2 hou2 do1 tai4

rows.note: Use this when the haphazard manner mainly reflects carelessness or a lack of attention to quality.

example.english: You wrote your report haphazardly and could not even be bothered to correct the typos.
example.traditional: 你份報告求其咁寫，連錯字都懶得改。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 kau4 kei4 gam3 se2 lin4 co3 zi6 dou1 laan5 dak1 goi2

rows.note: Use this especially when something has been haphazardly assembled from unrelated pieces or sources.

example.english: I put my presentation together haphazardly from completely unrelated sources.
example.traditional: 我份簡報東拼西湊咁整，啲資料來源完全唔同。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fan6 gaan2 bou3 dung1 ping3 sai1 cau3 gam3 zing2 di1 zi1 liu2 loi4 jyun4 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4
